import base64,hashlib,json,math,pathlib,zlib
from fractions import Fraction as F
R=pathlib.Path.cwd();S=1<<149
PLO=F('3.14159265358979323846264338327950288419716939937510')
PHI=F('3.14159265358979323846264338327950288419716939937511')
def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def digest(v):return sha(json.dumps(v,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).encode())
def q(v):return F(*v)
def value(w,domain=True):
    assert type(w) is int and 0<=w<1<<64
    e=(w>>52)&2047;m=w&((1<<52)-1);assert e!=2047
    if domain:assert e!=0 or m==0
    sign=-1 if w>>63 else 1
    return sign*F(m)*F(2)**(-1074) if e==0 else sign*F((1<<52)+m)*F(2)**(e-1075)
def nearest(w,x):
    candidates=[t for t in (w-1,w,w+1,0,1<<63) if 0<=t<1<<64 and (t>>52)&2047!=2047]
    assert w==min(candidates,key=lambda t:(abs(value(t,False)-x),t&1,t))
    return value(w)
def integer(words):
    assert len(words)==8 and all(type(v) is int and 0<=v<1<<32 for v in words)
    n=sum(w<<(32*i) for i,w in enumerate(words));return n-(1<<256) if words[-1]>>31 else n

    b=(R/p).read_bytes();assert sha(b)==h;return json.loads(b)
def payload(r):
    s=r if 'rc' in r else (r['test_run'] if 'test_run' in r else r['run']);b=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(s['stdout_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
    assert len(b)==s['stdout_bytes'] and sha(b)==s['stdout_sha256'];return json.loads(b)
def poly(x,odd,degree):
    return sum((F((-1)**j)*x**(2*j+odd)/math.factorial(2*j+odd) for j in range(degree+1)),F(0))
def permute(c,s,k):
    k%=4
    return (c,s) if k==0 else (-s,c) if k==1 else (-c,-s) if k==2 else (s,-c)
def validate(r):
    for n,h in r['code_doc_sha256'].items():assert sha((R/n).read_bytes())==h,n
    pr=r['previous_report'];previous=read_report(pr['path'],pr['sha256']);old=payload(previous)['audit']['cases']
    gr=previous['previous_report'];geo=payload(read_report(gr['path'],gr['sha256']))['cases']
    ar,ur=[read_report(p['path'],p['sha256']) for p in r['cache_reports']]
    ab={};ub={}
    for c in payload(ar)['audit']['cases'].values():
        for p in c['paths']:
            if p.get('argument_evaluated'):ab[tuple(p['measurement']['residual_signed256_words'])]=p['measurement']
    for c in payload(ur)['audit']['cases'].values():
        for p in c['paths']:
            if p.get('unit_evaluated') or p.get('unit_cache_reused'):ub[p['measurement']['angle_uint64']]=p['measurement']
    run=r['test_run'];assert run['rc']==0 and 'Ran 7 tests' in run['stderr'] and 'OK' in run['stderr']
    failed=r['initial_child_failures'][0];assert failed['rc']==1 and 'True is not false' in failed['stderr']
    assert payload(failed)==payload(run) # control fix ONLY; measurements/gates unchanged
    assert failed['code_doc_sha256_at_run']['Blender/benchmarks/capacity_audit/axial_geometry_unit_cpu_v1.py']==r['code_doc_sha256']['Blender/benchmarks/capacity_audit/axial_geometry_unit_cpu_v1.py']
    a=payload(run)['audit'];assert a['unit_model']==r['model'] and set(a['cases'])==set(old)
    assert a['pins_verified']==dict(previous['code_doc_sha256'],**{pr['path']:pr['sha256']})
    assert len(a['pins_verified'])==98 and len(r['code_doc_sha256'])==101

    for name,c in a['cases'].items():

            sel=op['selector'];words=sel['residual_cycles_signed256_words'];n=integer(words);residual=F(n,S)

            assert p['accepted_argument_CPU_only']==(phase<=budget)

            bylabel={}

                v=nearest(node['output_uint64'],expected);assert q(node['rounding_delta_rational'])==v-expected
                bylabel[node['label']]=v;stats['RN64_nodes_checked']+=1
            assert len(bylabel)==26 and um['RN64_operations']==26 and bylabel['square']==value(um['operations'][0]['output_uint64'])
            z=bylabel['square'];dz=z-x*x;pure=F(0)
